newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia arrests a suspected leader of Japanese cult.
newsitem.headline: Russia arrests a suspected leader of Japanese cult.

text.p: Russian border guards have arrested a suspected leader of the Russian branch of the Japanese cult Aum Shinri Kyo (Supreme Truth Sect), Interfax news agency said on Wednesday.
The man, named only as Mister Re, was stopped sometime during the past few days at the Russian port of Vyborg near the Finnish border, Interfax said, quoting a border guards spokesman.

"Mr Re was arrested as someone involved in the activities of the Aum Shinri Kyo sect, which is banned in Russia, and he is also charged with a string of terrorist acts in Japan," the agency quoted the spokesman as saying.
It said Re had been handed over to the regional office of the Federal Security Service (FSB), which said he was one of the organisers of the Russian branch of the sect.
"The arrested Japanese citizen is currently in Moscow, where an investigation is under way," an FSB source told the agency.
Officials from the FSB, successor organisation to the KGB, and the border guards, contacted by telephone, declined to comment on the Interfax report.
Sect leaders are on trial in Japan for murder after allegedly masterminding the March 20, 1995, gas attack on the Tokyo subway system, which killed 12 people and made 6,000 ill.
The sect established a branch in Russia in 1992 and claimed to have attracted several million followers before being banned by the Russian authorities after the Tokyo subway attack.
